title: The Four Views
lead: Christians have read the Bible's prophecies of the end, above all Revelation, Daniel and Jesus's sermon on the Mount of Olives (Matthew 24; Mark 13; Luke 21), in four main ways: as fulfilled in the first centuries (preterist), as a map of church history (historicist), as mostly still future (futurist), or as timeless patterns (idealist). Most academic scholars read the same texts historically, as words for their own time, without treating them as predictions of later events.
